# Fit quality of the ground model

<!-- Generated by `cargo run --example fit_doc`; do not edit by hand. -->

How dimple's ground model scores against every dataset its laws are fitted to or checked
against, one row per law and dataset, with the presets as they ship. The model and the
constants are described in [AERO.md](AERO.md#ground-model); the sources are listed under
References in the [README](../README.md#references).

**Regenerating.** `cargo run --example fit_doc` recomputes the **fixture** rows and rewrites
this file and `docs/fit-summary.csv`. Fixture rows use only numbers the sources print (fitted
equations, table rows, lines, Stimpmeter readings), so they regenerate anywhere; a test fails
when a change to the model moves one of them until this file is regenerated. **Summary** rows
are scored by the maintainers on per-impact datasets that dimple does not include or
redistribute: only their size, ranges and the resulting metrics are published, read from
`docs/fit-summary.csv`.

**Status.** Each row is `fixture` or `summary` as above, and `fit` or `check`. `fit` marks a
dataset the constants were fitted to (in-sample: the row shows how closely the fit
reproduces it); `check` marks a dataset no constant was fitted to (held out).

**Measures.** δ is the mean error of the outbound vector (both velocity components and the
spin, in scaled units) as a percentage of the inbound one, the measure of Biber et al. (2023).
ey is the vertical rebound ratio, COF the horizontal over the vertical impulse and D the
offset of the normal force ahead of the ball's center, all on the level surface (Cross 2025).
Biases are model minus measured.

## Where the model runs outside the data

- **Landings flatter than 16°.** No impact is measured below 16°. On the USGA's 2019 range
  test the roll-out is within 3 yd at 20–36° (rms 2 yd) and runs about 11 yd long at
  12–18°.
- **Shallow rebounds.** For landings flatter than about 35° the rebound is 0.07–0.15 livelier
  than measured (Biber et al. 2023; Cross 2021); see the ey bands above.
- **`GREEN` speed range.** `GREEN`'s friction is fitted to landings at 17–27 m/s. One green
  measured at 9–10 m/s (Cross 2025, Table 1) slides at about 0.29; a chip with 3,300 rpm of
  backspin leaves that green 1.3 m/s slower than this preset gives.
- **Rough and sand** have no measured impacts or rolls; see the README.
- **Aerodynamics** are not covered here: their fit quality is the "Fit quality" table of
  [AERO.md](AERO.md), scored on launch-monitor and reference sets that are not distributed.
